sign_or_frame.test: Mirror each measured port/starboard pair after translating and rotating into its own initial-heading frame; compare along-track directly and cross-track, heading change, sway, yaw rate and rudder after sign reflection.
sign_or_frame.prediction: A sign/frame bug is supported only by wrong reflected sign correlation or failed raw-data kinematic reconstruction. Magnitude mismatch with correct signs is asymmetry, not by itself an ingestion bug.

real_single_screw_asymmetry.test: Audit the MMG force equations and parameter file for sign-dependent coefficients and propeller-rotation terms, then quantify measured mirror residuals separately.
real_single_screw_asymmetry.prediction: Unequal positive/negative rudder-flow coefficients make some asymmetry representable; absent transverse propeller-rotation force leaves prop-walk asymmetry unrepresentable.

optimizer_nonlinearity_or_underdetermina.test: Repeat the original two-turning-circle fit from five fixed initial coefficient vectors without changing data, bounds, objective, regularization or iteration budget.
optimizer_nonlinearity_or_underdetermina.support_rule: At least two solutions within 2% of the best training cost must differ by normalized coefficient L2 distance > 1 and by >20% in median held-out heading or yaw-rate RMSE.
optimizer_nonlinearity_or_underdetermina.caveat: Failure to meet this rule does not prove identifiability; it only fails to demonstrate multi-start non-uniqueness under this optimizer budget.

immutability: No existing fit, protocol, or scoped-negative artifact may be modified.
